elements.element: The obligations are triggered upon expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: The clause applies "Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason."
Garman must, at Sparkling's request, "provide reasonable transition assistance."

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is required "for up to six (6) months."

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies "at Garman's then-current rates."

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Garman must, "within thirty (30) calendar days of such expiry or termination, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data."

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The required format is "a commonly used, machine-readable format," which satisfies the standard machine-readable requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After the return obligation, Garman must "thereafter delete Sparkling's data from its systems."

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data thereafter.
elements.evidence: Garman must "certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing."

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The clause requires transition assistance for up to six months at Sparkling's request, which includes a requested 90-day transition period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export or return Customer Data within 30 days.
elements.evidence: Garman must return all Sparkling data in a commonly used, machine-readable format within 30 calendar days.

result.reason: The operative clause fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It adds only transition, data-return, deletion, and certification terms relevant to the rule, with no apparent contradiction or unrelated commercial change. The drafting is clear as to trigger, responsible party, duration, rates, return deadline, format, deletion sequence, and written certification.
